description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Elected Chairman and Deputy Chairman for the Seethawaka Pradesiya Sabha
categorisation: The gazette content is a notification made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically announcing the date, time, and venue for the first meeting to elect the Chairman and Deputy Chairman of a local government authority. This directly pertains to the electoral process at the local government level, fitting the definition of **Elections Gazettes (Type 7)**, which includes election schedules and related administrative announcements.
